conviction_note: The release comes out AFTER the close (18:00 CEST on 2026-10-21), so the window that counts is 21 Oct close to 22 Oct close. findings.finding: Q3 shifted toward ETF and savings-plan trades. The cash-product share of transactions fell to 0.66 (Sep 0.62, the lowest in the 2025-26 series) from 0.70 in Q2, and ETF & funds rose to 0.26 (Sep 0.28) from 0.23. That points to a commission per transaction below the EUR 4.585 consensus implies (88.5 / 19.3; Q2 was EUR 4.64). At about EUR 4.50 x 19.21m, transaction commissions come to ~EUR 86.4m against 88.5m, a ~EUR 2m pre-tax shortfall, about 3% of the EUR 51.6m NI bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Commission per transaction has been a headline line in every release (Q2 'higher average commissions per transaction'). Q1 2026 printed a record quarter and the stock fell -7.77% and -9.73% over the next two sessions. Q2's NI beat and guide raise moved -0.27%. This name sells beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The mix is public, but consensus compiled on 15 Oct still implies only a 1.2% q/q decline in commission per trade while the cash-product share fell 3.6 points. If analysts had marked the mix down, the consensus commission line would sit nearer 86 than 88.5. It is partly priced: ODDO's 6 Oct note said Q3 expectations look slightly too high, and the stock is -22% over 20 days.

lessons_applied: 'A number the market has been told is worth 0': Q3 transaction volume moved from -0.1 to 0.0, and customer-acquisition and cash KPIs (public since 5 Oct) from -0.3 to -0.1.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the proxy-from-mix nature: the commission-mix finding was trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'the tail is intact': abs_move raised from 6 to 7, given new revenue and NI numbers, a possible guidance narrowing, 47.5% realised vol and this name's 2026 reactions of -8.6% and -7.8%/-9.7%.
'The move is in the guide': kept the guidance finding at -0.8 on the guidance scale with a wide -4 to +3 range.
'The session is the most load-bearing field': opened session_check with amc and the issuer's 18:00 CEST timestamp so the resolver uses the 21-to-22 Oct window.
Reaction history (this name sells beats: Q2 beat-and-raise moved -0.27%) supports the negative lean, but because the caution is already sell-side consensus, p_up was left at 45 rather than lowered.
